LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconBurnedOut: The goblin beacon has burned out.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconLoadCorpseDesc: Allow haulers to load a reachable goblin corpse into this beacon, or cancel this beacon's current loading request.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconIgniteDesc: Burn the loaded goblin corpse to send a signal. The beacon is consumed and draws attention to the colony.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconLoadCanceled: Goblin corpse loading canceled for this beacon.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconLoadEnabled: This beacon will accept a reachable goblin corpse.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconNeedCorpse: A goblin corpse must be loaded first.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconRequiresBlinia: Requires a primary ideology with either the Children of Blinia or Goblin Supremacy meme.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconDialogText:
Burning the goblin corpse releases a pheromone signal from the beacon and carries it far from the colony.

That smell may call allies to you, but it can also become a marker for something terrible.

Lured groups:
 - Goblins seeking to join and goblin caravans
 - Goblin refugees seeking temporary shelter (requires Royalty)
 - Hostile goblin raiders
 - Vengeful human goblin hunters
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconRitualAlreadyBurning: This goblin beacon is already burning.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconRitualNeedCaller: Only the ideology's leader or moral guide can call the goblin beacon signal. A lone colonist is exempt.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconRitualOutcomeText: The ritual sends a {0} signal across the region.\n\nRitual quality: {1}
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconJoinersLetterText: {0} goblins followed the beacon's smoke and scent. They want to join your mob permanently. Will you accept them?
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconJoinersAcceptedText: {0} goblins who followed the beacon have joined your mob.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconJoinersNoMap: There is no player settlement map for the joiners to enter.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconJoinersSpawnFailed: The goblin joiners could not find a reachable map-edge entry.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconJoinersRejected: The goblin joiners were turned away.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconHospitalityWarning: Goblins rarely reveal their true intentions even when asking for help. These refugees are more likely to betray their hosts than ordinary travelers, so keeping watch would be wise.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconRefugeeBetrayalText: The goblin refugees who followed the beacon have revealed their true intentions. They were waiting for a chance to strike from inside the colony!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinRefugeeBetrayalText: The goblin refugees who asked for shelter have revealed their true intentions. They were waiting for a chance to strike from inside the colony!
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotLadleDesc: Dispense one gut stew meal from stored ingredients.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotLadleFiveDesc: Ladle five gut stew meals at once when all five servings are available.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotCannotUseNoPath: Cannot use goblin stewpot: no path.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotCannotLoadNoIngredient: Cannot load goblin stewpot: no reachable humanlike meat or guts.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAutoFillDesc: Allow haulers to automatically bring guts and meat to this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAllowHumanGutsDesc: Allow human guts as the required gut component for this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAllowGoblinGutsDesc: Allow goblin guts as the required gut component for this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAllowHumanMeatDesc: Allow humanlike meat and human flesh chunks as nutrition for this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAllowGoblinMeatDesc: Allow goblin meat and goblin flesh chunks as nutrition for this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinStewpotAllowOtherMeatDesc: Allow ordinary animal meat as nutrition for this stewpot.
LanguageData.MUGB_DeployGoblinPheromonePackDesc: Crack the pack's jar open and release concentrated goblin pheromone gas around the wearer. It works like goblin stinkbomb gas, but hits non-goblins harder.
LanguageData.MUGB_ReloadGoblinPheromonePackDesc: Refill the empty pheromone pack with {0} goblin guts.
LanguageData.MUGB_NoGoblinGutToReloadPack: No stack with {0} goblin guts is reachable for reloading.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinPheromonePackReloaded: The pheromone pack has been refilled.
LanguageData.MUGB_GoblinBeaconHumanHuntersLetterText: The goblin beacon's scent has attracted more than allies.\n\nA hunting party from {0} has followed the beacon's smoke and stench to this place. They seem accustomed to tracking goblins and have taken the beacon as a mark of a goblin mob.
